  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "Crush {{ing_01|barley}}, soaked the day before, well washed."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "Place on the fire to be cooked [in a double boiler]."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "When hot add enough {{ing_02|oil}}, a {{ing_03|bunch of dill}}, {{ing_04|dry onion}}, {{ing_05|satury}} and {{ing_06|colocasium}} [2] to be cooked together."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "Because for the better juice, add {{ing_07|green coriander}} and a little {{ing_08|salt}}; bring it to a boiling point."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "When done take out the {{ing_03|bunch [of dill]}} and transfer the {{ing_01|barley}} into another kettle to avoid sticking to the bottom and burning."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "Make it liquid [by addition of water, {{ing_16|broth}}, milk]."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "Strain into a pot, covering the tops of the {{ing_06|colocasia}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 8,
      "text": "Next crush {{ing_09|pepper}}, {{ing_10|lovage}}, a little {{ing_11|dry flea-bane}}, {{ing_12|cumin}} and {{ing_13|sylphium}} [3]."
    },
    {
      "step": 9,
      "text": "Stir it well and add {{ing_14|vinegar}}, {{ing_15|reduced must}} and {{ing_16|broth}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 10,
      "text": "Put it back into the pot, the remaining {{ing_06|colocasia}} finish on a gentle fire [4]."
    }
  ],
